title: Battle of Neu Titschein
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Neu Titschein", at revision 1370270673, opens: "The Battle of Neu Titschein or Titschein was fought on 25 July 1621 during the Thirty Years' War between the Roman Catholic forces of Jean de Gauchier and the Protestant army of Johann Georg von Brandenburg, Duke of Jägerndorf." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q4871878, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "battle of the Thirty Years'War, 1621". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
